location_address: 955 Harbor Island Dr. San Diego, CA US 92101
description:
**The Sail:**
- We will cruise along Seaport Village, the Downtown Coastline, the Rady Shell, Coronado, and head to Glorietta bay where you can take a swim at the designated anchorage. With its steady wind we will sail calmly across the bay. These 4 hours are up to you where to go and what to do. You can also go see the sea lions, and go underneath the Coronado Bridge.

**What to Expect:**
- We will open sails if weather permits, so expect a little bit of leaning. It can get chilly when on the water so remember to bring warm clothes. Life Jackets will need to be worn by all guests age 12 and under. There are life jackets for everyone on board.

what_is_included_items.value: Bareboat Charter Captain Fee: $200 (included in total booking price)
Drinks: Coconut Water, Juice boxes, Flavored Sparkling Water and Water.
Snacks: Variety of cookies and chips

what_is_not_included:
- **Captain Gratuity:** 10-20% (optional but appreciated)
- **Parking Fees:** $20 per car for 3-5 hours in the marina parking lot (we currently do not have an onsite office)

In accordance with Coast Guard regulations, Bareboat Charters do not automatically include a captain. However, we have a roster list of skilled, USCG-licensed captains familiar with our program. If you choose this option, your total booking price **includes both the sailboat rental fee and the $200 captain fee**. We hold the captain's fee and pay it directly to the captain you chose on the day of your sail.
faqs:
- **What Do We Need To Bring?**
-- We recommend bringing warm clothes, a hat, sunscreen and removable shoes.
For this experience, you are more than welcome to bring your own foods and soft drinks

- **Do We Need To Wear Lifejackets?**
-- Everyone 12 years and younger must wear life jackets while onboard the vessel.


- **When to be there**
-- Please arrive 20 minutes before, for the marina is big and it’s easy to get lost. Your captain will meet you at our lockers, right next to Gate 2 ( the middle most gate), 15 minutes before departure time.
Please arrive on time. Our trip will be cut short if we leave late.
